Maria Chen: Quick FYI 1 I opened a fix for the API reference for POST /v1/generate. The old doc only listed response_format as ["json", "text"], but the service supports ["text", "json", "sse"] (default "text"). PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4598|#4598>. Please review and confirm SDK examples.
Oliver Park: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal corrected request/response schema here so I can check it quickly?
Maria Chen: Pasted into the PR, but copying the gist here:
```json
{ "request": { "type": "object", "properties": { "input": {"type":"string"}, "response_format": {"type":"string","enum":["text","json","sse"],"default":"text"}, "max_tokens": {"type":"integer"} }, "required":["input"] }, "response": { "type": "object", "properties": { "id":{"type":"string"}, "outputs":{"type":"array"} } } }
```
Kenji Sato: Noted one more bug: the cURL snippet has `max_tokens` as a quoted string. That should be an integer (no quotes). I'll push a one-line fix in the PR.
Maria Chen: Great 1 also updating the Python snippet to show SDK usage (positional kwargs) instead of raw REST JSON so it's less confusing for devs. Suggested snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(input="Summarize this document.", response_format="json", max_tokens=150)
print(resp.outputs[0].text)
```
Samir Patel: I'll update the Node/JS examples to use camelCase and call out the REST <-> SDK name mappings in a short note. Assigning the JS updates to me.
docs-bot: docs build succeeded for commit def456 (:white_check_mark:)
Lia Gomez: Quick Q: does requesting `response_format: "sse"` also require `stream=true`? We should clarify the streaming behavior in the docs. @Maria Chen
Maria Chen: Good catch. In this endpoint `response_format: "sse"` triggers server-sent events; it's functionally equivalent to `stream=true` for now but clearer to call out `sse` explicitly in examples. I added an SSE cURL example and a note about event payload shape in the PR.
Oliver Park: LGTM once Kenji's cURL fix lands. @Kenji Sato can you approve after you push?
Kenji Sato: Will do. Pushing the fix now. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll also add a short bullet in docs/migration/v1_to_v2.md explaining the expanded enum and recommended SDK patterns for backwards-compatible clients.
Maria Chen: Thanks all 1 I'll merge once CI finishes and Kenji approves. Ping me here for any extra param/response discrepancies.
metadata_notes: thread about API ref corrections including enum expansion, cURL fix, SDK snippet updates, and migration guide entry
